about: Reference answers for the Knowledge Graph question check (backend/graph/graph_eval.py). Each answerable question has a reference Cypher query; the check runs the query Claude writes and this one, and compares the results. 'compare' says how: 'rows' = the same rows, extra columns allowed; 'values' = every value of the reference appears somewhere in the result (for open-ended questions); 'length' = a path of the same number of hops (several shortest routes can tie). 'reviewed' is false until someone who knows the programme has checked the reference.

questions.question: Which systems are mentioned most often, and in how many documents?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(s:System) RETURN s.label AS system, count(DISTINCT d) AS documents ORDER BY documents DESC

questions.question: Which documents mention both SOVOS and SAP CPI, and in which passages?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(:System {code: 'SOVOS'}), (d)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(:System {code: 'CPI'}) RETURN DISTINCT d.filename AS document

questions.question: Which third-party systems appear in the DR documents?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {category: 'DR'})-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(s:System {kind: 'third_party'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.label AS system

questions.question: Which documents mention Salesforce but not SAP S/4HANA?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(:System {code: 'Salesforce'}) WHERE NOT (d)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(:System {code: 'S4HANA'}) RETURN d.filename AS document

questions.question: Which passages mention SAP S/4HANA and Salesforce together?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:MENTIONS]->(:System {code: 'S4HANA'}), (c)-[:MENTIONS]->(:System {code: 'Salesforce'}) RETURN c.chunk_key AS chunk

questions.question: How many documents mention each legacy ERP system (ECC, WP1, PF1, M3)?
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:System) WHERE s.code IN ['ECC', 'WP1', 'PF1', 'M3'] OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(s) RETURN s.code AS system, count(DISTINCT d) AS documents

questions.question: Which specifications implement a SPARK ticket, and which systems do they name?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:IMPLEMENTS_TICKET]->(t:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT t.ticket AS ticket, d.filename AS document

questions.question: Which documents reference SPARK-22234?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:REFERENCES_TICKET|IMPLEMENTS_TICKET]->(:Spec {ticket: 'SPARK-22234'}) RETURN DISTINCT d.filename AS document

questions.question: Which SPARK tickets are referenced by more than three documents?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:REFERENCES_TICKET|IMPLEMENTS_TICKET]->(t:Spec) WITH t, count(DISTINCT d) AS documents WHERE documents > 3 RETURN t.ticket AS ticket, documents
questions.note: No ticket is referenced by more than three documents (the most is three), so the right answer is none. A weak check: any query that returns nothing passes it.

questions.question: Which interface specifications mention SAP CPI?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:IMPLEMENTS_TICKET]->(:Spec), (d)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(:System {code: 'CPI'}) RETURN DISTINCT d.filename AS document

questions.question: Show the process hierarchy from 4.10.2.2 up to its value chain.
questions.cypher: MATCH (:Process {code: '4.10.2.2'})-[:SUBPROCESS_OF*0..]->(p:Process) RETURN p.code AS code

questions.question: What are the child steps of 4.10.2 Process Returns?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Process)-[:SUBPROCESS_OF]->(:Process {code: '4.10.2'}) RETURN c.code AS code, c.description AS step

questions.question: Which process steps under Lead to Cash are specified by the most documents?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:SPECIFIES_PROCESS]->(p:Process)-[:SUBPROCESS_OF*1..]->(:Process {code: '4.0'}) WITH p, count(DISTINCT d) AS documents ORDER BY documents DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.code AS code

questions.question: Which process codes do documents cite that are not in the BPML workbook?
questions.cypher: MATCH (:Document)-[:SPECIFIES_PROCESS]->(p:Process {in_bpml: false}) RETURN DISTINCT p.code AS code

questions.question: Which documents specify process O-020-090?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:SPECIFIES_PROCESS]->(:Process {code: 'O-020-090'}) RETURN d.filename AS document

questions.question: How many documents belong to each business stream?
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(s) RETURN s.code AS stream, count(DISTINCT d) AS documents

questions.question: Which documents belong to both Lead to Cash and Record to Report?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:Stream {code: 'L2C'}), (d)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:Stream {code: 'R2R'}) RETURN d.filename AS document

questions.question: Which systems are mentioned in Procure to Pay documents?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:Stream {code: 'P2P'}), (d)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(s:System) RETURN DISTINCT s.label AS system

questions.question: How many documents are in each category and format?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document) RETURN d.category AS category, d.format AS format, count(d) AS documents

questions.question: What is the shortest route between Solvay@eCommerce and SAP S/4HANA?
questions.cypher: MATCH p = shortestPath((:System {code: 'eCommerce'})-[*..6]-(:System {code: 'S4HANA'})) RETURN p

questions.question: Which documents connect SAP GTS and SAP EWM?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(:System {code: 'GTS'}), (d)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(:System {code: 'EWM'}) RETURN d.filename AS document

questions.question: Show me the graph around the SOVOS system.
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(:System {code: 'SOVOS'}) RETURN DISTINCT d.filename AS document

questions.question: Which passages in the SOVOS specification mention the digital signature?
questions.note: The graph keeps each passage's heading, not its text, so which passages mention a phrase is a question for Ask RAG. The right answer here is that the graph cannot say.

questions.question: Which chunks mention both a SPARK ticket and SAP CPI?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:MENTIONS]->(:Spec), (c)-[:MENTIONS]->(:System {code: 'CPI'}) RETURN DISTINCT c.chunk_key AS chunk

questions.question: For each system, which document mentions it most, and where?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[r:MENTIONS_SYSTEM]->(s:System) WITH s, d, r ORDER BY r.mentions DESC WITH s, collect(d)[0] AS top RETURN s.code AS system, top.filename AS document

questions.question: How many unique relationships are present in the knowledge graph and list each relationship name?
questions.cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS relationship, count(*) AS relationships
